purpose: #197: an unregistered $systf called as a task (nothing reads its value) is a no-op; the module is a 1 kohm resistor

oracle.derivation: The task's value is never read, so the branch is I = V/1k whatever the call returns. 1 kohm under 1 kohm from 1 V: v(out) = 1*1k/(1k+1k) = 0.5 V, i(vin) = -1/2k = -5e-4 A. No value of the $systf enters the derivation.
